Add git workflow rules: branch+PR only, no auto-commits

- All changes must go through feature branches and PRs
- Agents must never commit unless user explicitly asks
- CodeRabbit reviews all PRs before merge
- Branch protection enforced on main \(squash merge only\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add CodeRabbit configuration for automated PR reviews

Configure CodeRabbit with project-specific review instructions:
- Path-based rules for convex/, lib/api/, app/, components/, store/
- Enforces Convex auth validation, typed API responses, NativeWind usage
- Flags hardcoded API keys, missing error handling, raw API leaks
- Auto-review on all PRs to main, skip WIP/draft PRs
- Filters out skills directories and lock files from review
- Assertive review profile with change-request workflow
- Labels: expo, convex, api, ui, docs

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
